Three.js 0.180.0 (MIT)
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180

Vendored files: three.module.min.js, three.core.min.js, OrbitControls.js.
OrbitControls.js imports './three.module.min.js' instead of the bare 'three'
specifier so this application works without a bundler or runtime CDN.
